"'$out = [System.Text.StringBuilder]::new(); [void]$out.AppendLine('"'raw_id,report_year,track_type,severity_class,valid_damage_usd,valid_injured,valid_hazmat'); "'$count = 0; foreach ($page in $manifest.pages) { foreach ($line in Get-Content (Join-Path $base $page.file)) { if ($line.Length -eq 0) { continue }; $r = $line | ConvertFrom-Json; $damage = $null; $injured = $null; $hazmat = $null; if ($null -ne $r.damage_text -and ([string]$r.damage_text) -match $damagePattern) { $damage = [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse(([string]$r.damage_text).Replace('"',','')).ToString() }; if ("'$null -ne $r.injured_text -and ([string]$r.injured_text) -match $digitsPattern) { $injured = [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse([string]$r.injured_text).ToString() }; if ($null -ne $r.hazmat_released_text -and ([string]$r.hazmat_released_text) -match $digitsPattern) { $hazmat = [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse([string]$r.hazmat_released_text).ToString() }; if ($null -eq $damage -or $null -eq $injured -or $null -eq $hazmat) { $severity = '"'unknown' } elseif (([System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse("'$injured) -gt [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Zero) -or ([System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse($hazmat) -gt [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Zero) -or ([System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse($damage) -ge [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse('"'1000000'))) { "'$severity = '"'critical' } elseif ([System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse("'$damage) -ge [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse('"'100000')) { "'$severity = '"'high' } elseif ([System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse("'$damage) -ge [System.Numerics.BigInteger]::Parse('"'10000')) { "'$severity = '"'medium' } else { "'$severity = '"'low' }; "'$track = ([string]$r.track_type).Replace('"'\"','\"\"'); "'$fields = @([string]$r.raw_id, [string]$r.report_year, ('"'\"' + "'$track + '"'\"'), "'$severity, [string]$damage, [string]$injured, [string]$hazmat); [void]$out.AppendLine(($fields -join '"',')); "'$count++ } }; if ($count -ne 1000) { throw "Expected 1000 rows, found $count" }; [Console]::Write($out.ToString())'
